_comment: Per-borrower collateral map for the report's Collateral metrics box + Balance sheet review. Describes WHAT is pledged (from the credit agreement's security/collateral provisions) and WHICH monitoring-model balance-sheet row each pledged category maps to, so the report tracks collateral month over month and computes coverage vs funded debt. Produced by monitor-setup (sourced from covenant-setup / the credit agreement); the monthly report reads it from paths.collateral_map_path. Copy to collateral-map.json and fill in. Liabilities are NEVER collateral. Row labels match the model Balance Sheet sheet (column A, case-insensitive). Example values use a fictional borrower.
_lien_type_comment: one of: blanket (lien on substantially all assets — track the pledged asset lines + total, coverage vs funded debt); borrowing_base (a defined BB — fill the borrowing_base block); specific_assets (only the listed lines are pledged).
security_summary: Senior secured; blanket lien on substantially all assets; controlled deposit accounts. Source: executed credit agreement.

funded_debt_source._comment: Denominator for coverage ratios. Prefer the covenant-spec Indebtedness definition; else name the model BS debt rows to sum (value shapes as in budget-map: int-less here, use exact row labels).

_pledged_components_comment: Ordered pledged asset lines to track monthly. model_line = exact model BS row label, or {"add":[...],"subtract":[...]} to combine rows. tier drives the coverage cuts below: 'liquid' (cash + AR), 'tangible_ip', 'goodwill'. EXCLUDE any asset line that is not pledged. Include inventory ONLY if the borrower has it. The memo's Collateral box shows each component as level / MoM / YoY / vs Budget, with moves as dollar deltas plus % alongside; the vs-Budget column joins ON THIS 'label' to budget-map.json balance_sheet_rows (keep labels stable — renaming a component breaks its budget join).

coverage_cuts._comment: Named coverage ratios shown in the box = sum(components whose tier is in the list) / funded debt. Define the cuts relevant to the lien; the example progressively strips goodwill then non-liquid assets to show hard-asset coverage.

borrowing_base._comment: OPTIONAL — only when lien_type=borrowing_base. Advance rates against eligible collateral so the report shows availability vs drawn. Omit entirely for blanket liens.
